test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which bank of India has been awarded the Digital Transformation Award 2025 for digital initiatives—Pravaah and Sarthi by Central Banking, London, United Kingdom?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has been honored with the prestigious **Digital Transformation Award 2025** by **Central Banking Publications**, London.
 
• This recognition was given for the innovative digital initiatives **Pravaah** and **Sarthi**, which have been instrumental in enhancing the operational efficiency and service delivery of the RBI.
 
• **Pravaah** is a centralized web-based application that enables the seamless flow of information and decision-making within the RBI, streamlining processes and reducing delays.
 
• **Sarthi**, on the other hand, is a chatbot-based platform designed to improve communication and accessibility for various stakeholders, including the general public, government entities, and financial institutions.
 
• The award underscores the RBI's efforts to embrace **digital transformation** and leverage technology to maintain its leadership in the evolving financial landscape.
 
• The RBI plays a pivotal role in India's financial system as the **central bank**, responsible for formulating monetary policy, regulating banks, and ensuring financial stability.
 
• This recognition aligns with the RBI's commitment to fostering **innovation** and creating a resilient and inclusive financial ecosystem in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Punjab National Bank**__

 __
 
• **Punjab National Bank (PNB)** is one of India's largest public sector banks, headquartered in **New Delhi**.
 
• It offers a wide range of financial products and services, including retail banking, corporate banking, and asset management.
 
• The bank has been actively working on digitization and customer-centric initiatives but has not received the mentioned award.
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India**__
 __
 
• The **State Bank of India (SBI)** is the largest public sector bank in India, headquartered in **Mumbai**.
 
• It has a significant presence in both domestic and international markets and is known for its extensive digital banking services.
 
• Although SBI has implemented various digital initiatives, this particular award was given to the RBI.
 
 
 
• **Bandhan Bank**__
 
 
• **Bandhan Bank** is a private sector bank headquartered in **Kolkata**, primarily focused on serving the underbanked population.
 
• It started as a microfinance institution and transitioned into a full-fledged bank in **2015**.
 
• While Bandhan Bank has made efforts to enhance its digital infrastructure, it was not the recipient of the given award.
